cases.name: accumulate-without-a-list
cases.description: accumulate= turns a list into its running total, so without repeat= there is no list. Silently ignoring it would leave a config that looks like it keeps a total and does not.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="R"><gen type="number" value="10..99" accumulate="sum"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-accumulate-operation-that-does-not-exist
cases.description: The op is one of a short closed list. A misspelling has to be named rather than treated as "no accumulation", which would look like the feature simply not working.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="R"><gen type="number" value="10..99" repeat="3" accumulate="avg"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>
